title: Cinematic launch and refined onboarding
summary: Polish Night Roster into a more cinematic, native-feeling PWA while keeping everyday navigation stable and making the refreshed Chat onboarding explicit.
changes: Cold launch now uses a staged cinematic reveal tied to the real roster-loading state, then transitions smoothly into the app or sign-in experience without a fake loading delay.

First-use onboarding now uses directional page transitions, richer visual hierarchy and a current Chat page covering Team chat, private messages, @mentions, replies, privacy-safe notifications and 14-day retention.
Existing users receive the refreshed Chat introduction once, while Account still provides the complete onboarding replay.
Normal tab switching no longer animates the whole view, reducing movement and preserving the stable Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat layout.
Buttons, inputs, grouped surfaces, dark mode, sheets and persistent navigation receive restrained native-style polish with reduced-motion fallbacks.
